text: Students, if you decide to worship and obey the Lord, be ready to face problems.
Have firm self-control and don't act too quickly if trouble strikes.
Don't turn from the Lord, but be faithful; that's the way to succeed.
Accept everything that happens. Be patient if others humiliate you—
humiliation tests people as a furnace tests gold.[10]
The Lord will give his help, if you depend only on him and do right.
If you fear the Lord and are patient, he will show you mercy. But if you turn away, you will fall.
Put your trust in him, and he will reward you.
Don't give up hoping for good things, like mercy and a life full of joy.
Look at past generations— did the Lord desert those people who trusted and feared him? Or did he fail to answer those who asked him for help?
The Lord is kind and shows mercy by forgiving our sins and rescuing us from trouble.
But the Lord will send trouble if you don't have the courage to be faithful and to stay away from sin.
If you are too afraid to put your trust in him, he will not protect you when problems come.
And if you give up, you will be in for trouble when the Lord decides to judge your life. *
If you love the Lord and respect him, you will obey his commands.
You will try to please him and to be completely faithful to his Law.
If you fear the Lord, you will prepare yourself to worship him with humility.
We pray, Lord, that you will decide our future. You are as merciful as you are majestic,[11] so don't leave our fate in human hands.
